PLSC 250 not GS 290!!
Loved her as a teacher and person. Super caring and accessible, and really tried to make the class as easy as possible for us. That being said, the tests were hard to do well on even if you know the material she wants super specific answers. The in class essays and quizzes definitely carried my grade.

This is not an easy class if you are taking Petrova. Her class style is unconventional, mainly student-led facilitations that she will take over at the end of each class. 2 papers and 2 exams. She is super accessible outside of class, but she has very high expectations that sometimes seemed impossible. All questions are short answer

Amazing lecturer. However, content for exams was really hard to predict and there were no study guides. Reading materials and participating in class is not enough for a good grade. Harsh grader, but very approachable and kind. I believe the grading could sometimes be less subjective, considering it is sometimes really harsh.
She is the most dedicated and kind professor I have ever had at UR. Participate in class and you should be good. Amazing professor who cares a lot about her students
